component.name: Aliens Invaders
component.summary: Modern vertical arcade space shooter powered by C++20 and SDL3

description.p: Aliens Invaders is an arcade vertical space combat game engineered natively for Wayland and modern display architectures using modern C++20 and native SDL3.

Features include GPU-accelerated double buffering, tear-free subpixel interpolation, procedural sound synthesis, Barry-Goldman centripetal Catmull-Rom splines, fair-play anti-scissor ballistics, and tactical nuclear munitions.
C++20 Clean Architecture milestone with decoupled components, pure math tests, and zero warnings.
